original.reason: It assumes the required group structure and normal forms without proof; equal orders of images do not make the proposed assignment well defined; and injectivity is asserted using an unproved unique expression c^i d^j.

judgment.reason: The exponent choices for G and G' are conflated. Replacing a by a^l changes its action by the l-th power, so the asserted relation-preserving map does not generally follow.

It correctly identifies the normal Sylow p-subgroup, the faithful nontrivial action of C_q, and shows differing generators of the unique order-q automorphism subgroup yield isomorphic semidirect products.

It incorrectly says replacing a by a^l changes an action with exponent k^{l(p-1)/q} to the standard exponent. One needs a suitable inverse power instead. This false step leaves the stated normalization unjustified.
It correctly normalizes one action, parameterizes the other, and the map c↦a^l, d↦b preserves the action and is surjective; equal finite orders make it an isomorphism.
